title: Reflection debuts Beam,开放-权重 AI 模型 到 rival Chinese 模型 在 lower compute 成本
content: Reflection 是 aiming Beam 和 未来 模型 在 enterprises 和 sovereign 国家.pitch 是 到 构建 “AI factories,” 产品 那个 将会 let 机构 构建 他们的 own 定制,本地 AI 系统 由 训练 Reflection’s AI 模型 在 他们的 own proprietary 数据.
original_title: Reflection debuts Beam, an open-weight AI model to rival Chinese models at lower compute cost
original_content: Reflection is aiming Beam and future models at enterprises and sovereign nations. The pitch is to build “AI factories,” a product that would let institutions build their own customized, local AI system by training Reflection’s AI models on their own proprietary data.
